FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS t0

  t0.order_date BETWEEN CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2024-12-31' AS DATE)

FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS t0
